name: page-sections
goal: Pages expose Uses but no Used In tab or section; existing Used In links open Overview.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Pages should expose Overview, Contract, Uses, States, History and Source only. Existing page Used In URLs should open Overview while preserving branch/commit; other entity kinds retain Used In.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Standardized usage, details and visual-overview tests explicitly require Used In for pages. Strengthen those existing tests for category-specific navigation, direct page Used In inputs, canonical addresses, current/history and all three browser widths; retain non-page consumer coverage.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed 38068f32 before product repair. Frozen red record ec9f6a2fe478c52cbefccaa72be18c80a3e4057b947778ff1beef95c1beb7fa4 rejects Page Used In in unit and browser checks at all three widths. Current Helpers labels replace stale Functions labels without changing navigation, counts or timing limits; the unrelated console case now passes before repair.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 745346c5 removes page consumer navigation and panels and canonicalizes old links without changing non-page usage.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged frozen regression passes at 745346c5: record bd04f68b1b190e1705643a7ceceea172c35a7806674eee3d9f61c716e1049be4; 61 root and 23 reports tests plus 9 browser cases.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
